summary: Wrote a 6-phase, 9.75-hour plan applying the mode-gated section-loading convention to skill-literature (7 mode sections, 84,308 B) and skill-distill (9 sub-mode sections, 65,329 B). The task's named distill target does not exist as a section -- '## Auto Distill Complete' is fence-interior -- so the distill scope was re-derived from the real dispatch structure and the deviation recorded as a non-blocking user_decision.

artifacts.summary: 6 phases, 4 dependency waves, 16 extractions, measured-reduction and acceptance-walk gating in the final phase.

user_decision.question: Task 89's distill target (a 43,254 B '## Auto Distill Complete' output-template section) does not exist -- that string is inside a fenced output example, and the 43,254 B figure is the fence-interior-heading artifact itself (it sweeps up five unrelated sub-mode specs). The real '### Sub-Mode: auto' is only 3,358 B. How should the distill half of this task be scoped to still hit the ~42.4k -> ~32k token goal?
options: Extract all nine above-bar '### Sub-Mode:' sections (purge, merge, compress, refine, revise, meta, review, learn, dream) = 65,329 B removed -- wider than described, but the only scope that reaches the stated token target
Extract only the three sections over the 8,000 B lint threshold (revise, meta, merge) = 29,300 B removed -- closest to the described single-extraction size, falls short of the ~32k target
Drop the distill half and re-scope task 89 to skill-literature only, filing distill as a new task against corrected measurements
user_decision.recommended: Extract all nine above-bar '### Sub-Mode:' sections (purge, merge, compress, refine, revise, meta, review, learn, dream) = 65,329 B removed -- wider than described, but the only scope that reaches the stated token target
